reasons_first_over_second: EXPONENT VERSUS COFACTOR, THE GOVERNING BIAS. Under the target-result profile rule A1 - constant-factor speedups, implementation tuning and logarithmic-cofactor improvements are valuable engineering but are not target-class - candidate A sits in the H-STR-002 lane, whose only reproducible effect is the constant factor r = 3 measured at 2.62 to 3.20x. Candidate B's primary metric is the search exponent in N as the endomorphism rank rises, and its F1 branch would identify an exponent-relevant mechanism. Only one of the two can move an exponent in either direction.

THE REPLICATION OBLIGATION IS NOT YET DUE. The `weaken` in DEC-20260727-002 rests on three grounds - absent artifacts, the one-variable comparison, and the absence of any assembled system or archived baseline - that the decision states are independent of the instrument question. The replication EXP-STR-004 owes binds the NEXT transition of H-STR-002 in either direction. BATCH-009 proposes no such transition, so deferring A defers no decision and leaves no claim resting on an unreplicated basis. This is recorded as the resume condition of DEFER-BATCH009-001, not as a discharge of it.

REFUTATION-ARTIFACT STRENGTH. Candidate A can produce, at best, another instrument statistic about a metric that DEC-20260727-002 declares UNADJUDICATED after criterion F1 fired at B = 27 and B = 397. Candidate B produces exactly integer Hermite normal form indices, certificate-verified witnesses replayed on the curve with [k] P = Q checked, a PLANTED positive control that voids its own negatives if undetected, and a known-answer calibration against the classical 0.886 sqrt(N/|Aut|). Those are the strongest checkable artifacts this campaign can currently buy at low cost, and the coordinator contract requires seeking the strongest such artifact before any weakening conclusion.

ROADMAP GATING. Candidate B carries the load-bearing part of IDEA-20260727-005's exit-map classification barrier. A confirmation bounds what that barrier may be promoted to and tells the program to stop spending compute on endomorphism-rich factor bases and displacement structure; a refutation collapses 005 and reopens the lane BEFORE compute is committed to IDEA-20260727-006 or -007. Candidate A gates nothing outside its own lane.

Candidate B's higher-rank cells are SYNTHETIC because only three efficiently computable eigenvalues exist at j = 0 and two at j = 1728. The r sweep beyond those bounds tests lattice geometry, not a realizable attack, and the contract says so.

rationale: THE EXPERIMENT MEASURES THREE THINGS AT ONCE BECAUSE NO ONE OF THEM DISCRIMINATES ALONE. Index pinning alone is an elementary theorem; shrinkage alone looks like progress; cost neutrality alone is unexplained. Shrinkage WITHOUT cost reduction is the falsifiable signature of a pinned determinant, and shrinkage WITH cost reduction is the informative failure that would reopen the lane. Measuring all three under one frozen contract is what makes this a discriminator rather than a demonstration.

THE CONTRACT IS FROZEN BEFORE EXECUTION AND SNAPSHOT-COMMITTED BEFORE ANYONE READS IT. The pre-registration ordering that gives the result its evidential value is a property of commit order, which is why TASK-20260728-003 runs alone and stages no driver, no result and no run.

EVERY PREDICTED NUMBER CARRIES ITS BASIS. The contract derives 2^(r+1), the index N and the slope 1 inside its own derivation section; it cites 0.886 to the classical rho literature as a known-answer calibration this campaign has never measured; and it labels every band and tolerance a pre-registered untested judgement. Nothing is copied from an unarchived probe, which is the defect that cost an earlier batch when a frozen experiment falsified its own pre-registered values.

THE HEURISTICS ARE VALIDATED IN THE SAME BATCH. H-ENDO-001 declares two heuristic assumptions and each has its own arm - RUN-ENDO-001-F-H1 samples the witness count against the Poisson prediction with an exact tail check that Minkowski forces to zero, and RUN-ENDO-001-G-H2 tests eigenvalue genericity by Kolmogorov-Smirnov over at least 500 curves. A conditional prediction is not dispatched here without its validation.

THE INSTRUMENT MUST PROVE IT CAN SEE A POSITIVE BEFORE ITS NEGATIVES COUNT. CTRL-COLLAPSE plants a genuine determinant collapse; if the instrument misses it, the run set is INVALID rather than negative and every P1 negative it produced is void. CTRL-RANDSUB gives the endomorphism curve something it could have differed from, and CTRL-GENJ bounds the implementation penalty at r = 1 against matched BSGS.

THE BATCH IS BOUNDED AND CHEAP. Nine cards, 23100 seconds of declared task budget, one experiment, eight run records, 8 GB, one machine, four field sizes at most 28 bits. It cannot meet a completion criterion of this goal under any outcome and is not dispatched as if it could.
